Obtain one scratch-org standard user and create a second synthetic standard user using the data API. Sort their IDs. Create three ApexEmailNotification records using the data API: one with only Email set to probe@example.invalid and two with UserId set to the lower and higher user IDs respectively. Re-query all three UserId values and identify records as N, L, H. At each API version query the three records with ORDER BY UserId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST. Apex DML does not support creating this object.
